caption: The drawing features a wooden object composed of three main parts: a vertical cylindrical rod, a central circular disk, and a base made up of four roughly rectangular segments arranged in a cross-like shape. The cylindrical rod extends vertically through the center of both the disk and the base. The disk is positioned perpendicular to the rod, situated about two thirds of the way up from the base, and appears to be attached securely. The four sections of the base are rounded at the ends and each segment connects at the center where the rod is inserted. The wood is depicted in light to medium brown tones with visible grain patterns, suggesting an unpainted, natural finish. The illustration is set against a plain, light beige background which provides contrast to the wooden object's earthy hues.
title: Dasher for Butter Churn
